environment.description: Production Kubernetes deployment behind Istio service mesh. Split.io SDK initialized with production API key (sdk-prod-7xm9q). The targeting rule for flag 'legacy_binary_cache_import' in the production workspace evaluates to treatment='off' for all segments — the flag definition has zero 'on' treatments configured (default rule: off, individual targets: empty, percentage rollout: 0%). The flag was created in 'killed' state and has never been activated in the production workspace. Split's impression listener logs confirm zero 'on' impressions in production over the past 180 days. Additionally, the Split SDK is configured with `streamingEnabled=false` and sync interval of 300s, meaning even if the flag were changed, propagation would take 5 minutes — but the flag definition itself has an approval workflow requiring 2 production SRE approvals before any targeting rule modification in the prod workspace. The JVM has commons-collections 3.2.1 on classpath. Container runs as UID 1000.
